verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's documented local-first design implies user data never reaches a vendor that could train on it: it 'runs entirely on your computer', has 'no data leaving your device', uses 'no cloud processing', and offers self-hosting via Docker or on-premise. However, the pack contains no explicit statement or policy that data is never used for training. The hosted and bring-your-own-API-key options also route data to third-party LLM providers without any documented training safeguard. missing for 10: explicit no-training policy or guarantee, training opt-out controls for hosted/cloud-LLM configurations, independent corroboration of the privacy claims.
